GEN-024 positive/negative leaf and parent fields match exactly.

All pinned references in the R02, R03, R04, R05 and R06 freeze chains match local hashes, including freezes, bundles, H reviews, source preimages, selected postimages, operation ledger/schema and retained projection. R07 crosswalk postimage is byte-identical to prior cuts. R07 freeze and rebuild records state canonicalApply NONE and phaseStatusEffect NONE.
